brief: Opening of a practical article on why reporting projects stall, for operations leaders. Plain, accessible language.
job_context: Brand: Northwind Data, a fictional data platform company. Audience: operations leaders at mid-sized companies. No brand profile.
inputs: Reporting projects often stall after the first demo because data ownership is unclear after the project team leaves.

The kickoff went well. The slides were great. Everyone nodded. And then, silence.

Reporting projects stall after the first demo because nobody owns the numbers once the project team leaves. The demo runs on a clean sample, while the live report depends on data that three departments maintain in different ways.
